reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens the refined idea (drop OOF, pass sub-threshold softmax probs >= 0.05 into relink at BONUS 1.0/1.5) cannot be validated as a real, private-transferable gain. (1) The in-sample leak is maximal exactly where the lab scores: train_unet_transformer.py line 56 supervises 'BCE on annotated rows and columns' only, so the evaluable pairs (those touching GT nodes with successor/predecessor) are precisely the network's training targets on all 199 videos. Sub-threshold probabilities on those pairs are memorised signal locally and weaker on unseen embryos; the unannotated pairs where the net is honest are free in the metric. Any local gain in the ~450 TP / ~340 FP pockets is therefore an upper bound inflated by the leak. (2) Direct LB precedent in the same direction: probe 22 (relink learned bonus 2.5, more trust in net probs in relink) = 0.945 vs 0.947, and probe 21 relink-off was +0.0053 locally and -0.002 on LB. The BONUS 1.5 variant is the probe-22 knob again. Three relink-stage changes all landed at -0.002, so the relink stage is at its optimum for the hidden embryo. (3) The research's own expected gain is +0.000..+0.001 local, below the +0.002 gate, and it rules out a stand-alone LB probe. That leaves no out-of-sample check: the in-sample lab is the only evidence, and its known local-to-LB transfer for edge-net-trusting changes has been negative twice. (4) Dropping the OOF retrain also removes the only mechanism that would make the lab honest. Its replacement audit (probe 29) tests ef, not the plumbing. Not a node-multiplier artefact (relink-only, edge_prob kept separate, node counts about unchanged), and 44b6 crop redundancy is not the driver (selection is 6bba). The failure is the in-sample edge network plus a sub-gate effect size.
fix_if_any: Only a version that is neutral by construction for unseen embryos survives. Keep BONUS 1.0 (never 1.5), and let the sidecar prob act only as a tie-breaker: apply it only when two relink options differ in motion cost by < 0.3 um, and cap it at 0.48 x BONUS. Require the lab gain to hold (1) on the 71 44b6 videos with 6bba excluded from threshold picking and (2) when the sidecar probs are coarsened to rank-within-target (removes absolute-calibration leak). Even then, ship it only bundled into a probe whose other component already transferred (for example after probe 29 scores >= 0.951), never alone, and treat a local gain below +0.002 as zero. An honest OOF check needs a from-scratch fold retrain of the transformer (UNet features also saw the edge loss), which does not fit the 5-day, ~20 GPU-hour budget.
realistic_public_gain: About 0.000 (range -0.002 to +0.001). The local +0.000..+0.001 is inflated by the in-sample network on exactly the evaluable pairs, and the same-direction relink knob (probe 22) lost 0.002 on LB. Not worth an LB slot; no measurable private gain expected.
